issues.display_title: Issue #565: Centralize Visibility and Standardize Query Errors Across Remaining Actions
issues.main_description_html:
Implementation: Centralize Content and User Visibility Across All Actions

Summary

Completed a repository-wide sweep to replace manual Redis queries (_deactive_users_ec, _blocked_users_ec_, _blocked_post_ec_) and manual user data decodes (UserFunctions.UserDatas) with the centralized visibility functions Functions.ResolveContentVisibility and Functions.ResolveUserVisibility. In addition, all database query error responses in these actions have been standardized from HTTP 500 to standard HTTP 400 Bad Request ("Failed to get data").

Scope & Files Refactored

1. Bookmarks & Affiliate

  • src/Action/V1/Bookmarks/ListBookmarks.go:
    • Replaced manual Redis string list reads and UserDatas with Functions.ResolveContentVisibility.
    • Replaced HTTP 500 database error responses with standard HTTP 400 Bad Request ("Failed to get data").
  • src/Action/V1/Bookmarks/ListPublishedFolderBookmarkProfile.go:
    • Replaced manual Redis lookups and UserDatas with Functions.ResolveUserVisibility.
    • Standardized database error responses to HTTP 400 Bad Request.
  • src/Action/V1/Affiliate/ListAffiliateCategories.go:
    • Replaced manual user context lookup with Functions.ResolveUserVisibility.
    • Standardized count/scan error responses from HTTP 500 to HTTP 400 Bad Request.

2. CollectionPost, Hashtag & MentionPosts

  • src/Action/V1/CollectionPost/ListCollectionPost.go:
    • Replaced manual Redis lookups for deactivated/blocked users and posts with Functions.ResolveContentVisibility.
  • src/Action/V1/Hashtag/SearchHashtagPost.go:
    • Replaced manual Redis queries and user decodes with Functions.ResolveContentVisibility.
    • Standardized query execution errors to HTTP 400 Bad Request ("Failed to get data").
  • src/Action/V1/MentionPosts/TaggedPosts.go:
    • Replaced manual Redis calls and UserDatas with Functions.ResolveContentVisibility.
    • Standardized pagination with Functions.Pagination(c, 9).
    • Standardized query execution errors to HTTP 400 Bad Request.
  • src/Action/V1/MentionPosts/SearchMentioningUser.go:
    • Added Username field to ContentVisibility struct in Functions.go to support username filtering cleanly.
    • Replaced manual Redis queries and UserDatas with Functions.ResolveUserVisibility.
    • Standardized query error response to HTTP 400 Bad Request.

3. Posts & Users

  • src/Action/V1/Posts/DetailPost.go:
    • Replaced multiple manual Redis calls (deactive_users, blocked_users, blocked_post) with Functions.ResolveContentVisibility.
    • Standardized ElasticSearch post count error handling from HTTP 500 to HTTP 400 Bad Request.
  • src/Action/V1/Posts/ListBlockedPost.go:
    • Replaced manual Redis lookup and UserDatas with Functions.ResolveContentVisibility.
    • Standardized query error response to HTTP 400 Bad Request.
  • src/Action/V1/Posts/TimeLineListPostProfile.go:
    • Replaced manual Redis calls and UserDatas with Functions.ResolveContentVisibility.
    • Standardized processing query error response to HTTP 400 Bad Request.
  • src/Action/V1/Users/ListBlockedUser.go:
    • Replaced manual Redis lookups and UserDatas with Functions.ResolveUserVisibility.
    • Standardized query error response from HTTP 500 to HTTP 400 Bad Request.

Backward Compatibility & Safety

  • No Breaking Changes:
    • All endpoint routes, parameter names, and URL decoding remain identical.
    • Response JSON bodies, data structures, fields, and encrypted envelopes (cry, ls, e4) match 100%.
  • Cleaner Architecture:
    • Eliminated repetitive Redis boilerplate across 11 action files.
    • Eliminated HTTP 500 Internal Server Errors on normal database query failures in favor of standard HTTP 400 Bad Request.

Verification

go test -count=1 ./src/Action/...
go vet ./src/Action/...
go build ./...

Results:

  • All action tests pass across all packages with zero failures.
  • go vet passes cleanly.
  • go build ./... compiles cleanly with zero errors.

Problem

Across several domain packages (Bookmarks, Affiliate, CollectionPost, Hashtag, MentionPosts, Posts, and Users), 11 non-slim action handlers still performed manual Redis string list reads (_deactive_users_ec, _blocked_users_ec_, _blocked_post_ec_) and manual user token decodes via UserFunctions.UserDatas. Maintaining ad-hoc Redis fetching created logic fragmentation and potential drift in how blocked or deactivated accounts were handled.

Furthermore, several of these endpoints returned HTTP 500 Internal Server Errors when common database scans or queries failed, which can trigger critical system-down alerts on frontend and mobile clients instead of standard business-level errors.

Scope

  • Add the Username field to Functions.ContentVisibility in src/Utils/Functions/Functions.go to support username exclusions without requiring extra queries.
  • Refactor the 11 action files to adopt Functions.ResolveContentVisibility and Functions.ResolveUserVisibility:
    • src/Action/V1/Bookmarks/ListBookmarks.go
    • src/Action/V1/Bookmarks/ListPublishedFolderBookmarkProfile.go
    • src/Action/V1/Affiliate/ListAffiliateCategories.go
    • src/Action/V1/CollectionPost/ListCollectionPost.go
    • src/Action/V1/Hashtag/SearchHashtagPost.go
    • src/Action/V1/MentionPosts/TaggedPosts.go
    • src/Action/V1/MentionPosts/SearchMentioningUser.go
    • src/Action/V1/Posts/DetailPost.go
    • src/Action/V1/Posts/ListBlockedPost.go
    • src/Action/V1/Posts/TimeLineListPostProfile.go
    • src/Action/V1/Users/ListBlockedUser.go
  • Eliminate redundant manual Redis string list calls and unused Redis/context imports.
  • Standardize database query failure responses across these files from HTTP 500 to standard HTTP 400 Bad Request ("Failed to get data").
  • Strictly preserve all existing endpoint routes, parameter names, payload shapes, and encryption behaviors.

Behavior Boundary

The refactor must preserve:

  • All URL route definitions, route parameters, and query parameters.
  • Role validations (user, viewer, my-user) and header checks (c.Get("role") != role).
  • Blocked post and blocked user rejection rules (returning HTTP 403 Forbidden).
  • Response envelopes, messages, JSON field names, types, and values.
  • Encryption envelopes (ec=true), including cry, ls, and viewer e4 properties.
  • Slim, SL, and Worker files remain strictly excluded.

Out of Scope

  • Changing database tables, relations, or migration scripts.
  • Modifying slim models or slim response endpoints.
  • Auto-committing or pushing git changes.

Acceptance Criteria

  • All 11 targeted action files use ResolveContentVisibility or ResolveUserVisibility.
  • Direct manual Redis calls to _deactive_users_ec, _blocked_users_ec_, and _blocked_post_ec_ are eliminated from these actions.
  • Database query errors in these actions return HTTP 400 Bad Request instead of HTTP 500.
  • go test -count=1 ./src/Action/... passes with zero failures.
  • go vet ./src/Action/... passes cleanly.
  • go build ./... succeeds with zero errors.

Delivery

Implemented in the working tree on 2026-09-11. No commit was created.

issues.display_title: Issue #567: Centralize Visibility and Error Handling Across Remaining Actions
issues.main_description_html:
Implementation: Centralize Remaining Action Visibility and Query Errors

Summary

Completed the consolidation of all remaining non-slim action handlers that still performed manual Redis lookups (_deactive_users_ec, _blocked_users_ec_, _blocked_post_ec_) and manual user data decodes. All candidate endpoints in Likes, Comments, Notifications, and Users now adopt Functions.ResolveContentVisibility or Functions.ResolveUserVisibility. All database query errors in these handlers have been standardized from HTTP 500 to standard HTTP 400 Bad Request ("Failed to get data").

Scope & Files Refactored

1. Shared Utilities

  • src/Utils/Functions/Functions.go:
    • Added DeactivatedUsers []string to ContentVisibility struct to cleanly support endpoints that check deactivated users separately from blocked users without requiring direct Redis reads.

2. Likes Package

  • src/Action/V1/Likes/ListProfileLikedPosts.go:
    • Replaced manual Redis string list reads (_deactive_users_ec, _blocked_users_ec_, _blocked_post_ec_) inside listProfileLikedPosts with visibility.BlockedPosts and visibility.ExcludedUsers.
    • Replaced manual pagination arithmetic with Functions.Pagination(c, 9).
    • Standardized database count and scan errors from HTTP 500 to HTTP 400 Bad Request ("Failed to get data").
    • Removed unused context and Redis imports.

3. Comments Package

  • src/Action/V1/Comments/PreviousCommentRequest.go:
    • Replaced manual UserFunctions.UserDatas and manual Redis queries for blocked posts, blocked users, and deactivated users with Functions.ResolveContentVisibility.
    • Removed unused context, Config, UserFunctions, and Redis imports.
  • src/Action/V1/Comments/ListPreviousComment.go:
    • Standardized query error response from HTTP 500 to HTTP 400 Bad Request.
  • src/Action/V1/Comments/ListPreviousReplyComment.go:
    • Standardized query error response from HTTP 500 to HTTP 400 Bad Request.
  • src/Action/V1/Comments/PreviousCommentRequest_test.go:
    • Added unit test verifying preparePreviousCommentRequest rejects invalid roles.

4. Notifications Package

  • src/Action/V1/Notifications/ListNotifications.go:
    • Replaced manual UserFunctions.UserDatas and manual Redis lookups for deactivated and blocked users with Functions.ResolveUserVisibility.
    • Standardized database query and post data retrieval error responses to HTTP 400 Bad Request.
    • Removed unused context, UserFunctions, and Redis imports.
  • src/Action/V1/Notifications/ListNotificationMonth.go:
    • Replaced manual UserFunctions.UserDatas and manual Redis lookups with Functions.ResolveUserVisibility.
    • Standardized database query and post data retrieval error responses to HTTP 400 Bad Request.
    • Removed unused context, UserFunctions, and Redis imports.
  • src/Action/V1/Notifications/ListNotifications_test.go:
    • Added unit tests verifying role validation for ListNotifications and ListNotificationMonth.

5. Users Package

  • src/Action/V1/Users/ProfileUser.go:
    • Replaced manual UserFunctions.UserDatas and manual Redis reads for deactivated and blocked users with visibility.DeactivatedUsers and visibility.BlockedUsers.
    • Standardized social links and follow queries error responses from HTTP 500 to HTTP 400 Bad Request.
    • Removed unused context, UserFunctions, and Redis imports.
  • src/Action/V1/Users/ProfileUserBySid.go:
    • Replaced manual UserFunctions.UserDatas and manual Redis lookups for blocked users with Functions.ResolveUserVisibility.
    • Removed unused context, UserFunctions, and Redis imports.
  • src/Action/V1/Users/ProfileFollowing.go:
    • Replaced manual UserFunctions.UserDatas and manual Redis queries for deactivated and blocked users with Functions.ResolveUserVisibility.
    • Standardized query and followed lookup errors from HTTP 500 to HTTP 400 Bad Request.
    • Removed unused context and Redis imports.
  • src/Action/V1/Users/ProfileFollower.go:
    • Replaced manual UserFunctions.UserDatas and manual Redis queries for deactivated and blocked users with Functions.ResolveUserVisibility.
    • Standardized query and followed lookup errors from HTTP 500 to HTTP 400 Bad Request.
    • Removed unused context and Redis imports.
  • src/Action/V1/Users/ProfileUser_test.go:
    • Added unit tests verifying role rejection for ProfileUser and ProfileUserBySid.

Backward Compatibility & Safety

  • 100% Contract Preserved:
    • All endpoint paths, query parameters, route parameters, response keys, messages, and encrypted payloads (cry, ls, e4) remain identical.
    • Role checks and blocked user / blocked post prohibitions (403 Forbidden with exact message text and payload keys) remain completely intact.
  • Non-Slim Exclusivity:
    • Zero changes made to any *Slim.go or worker files.

Verification

go test -v ./src/Action/V1/Likes/...
go test -v ./src/Action/V1/Comments/...
go test -v ./src/Action/V1/Notifications/...
go test -v ./src/Action/V1/Users/...
go test -v ./src/Utils/Functions/...
go vet ./src/Action/V1/...
go build ./...

All tests pass cleanly, vet reports zero issues, and go build ./... compiles with zero errors.

Problem

Following the initial centralization passes, several action handlers across Likes, Comments, Notifications, and Users still contained manual Redis string list reads (_deactive_users_ec, _blocked_users_ec_, _blocked_post_ec_) and manual user data calls (UserFunctions.UserDatas):

  1. Likes:

    • src/Action/V1/Likes/ListProfileLikedPosts.go performed manual Redis reads for deactivated users, blocked users, and blocked posts inside listProfileLikedPosts, manual pagination calculations, and returned HTTP 500 on database scan errors.

  2. Comments:

    • src/Action/V1/Comments/PreviousCommentRequest.go manually called UserFunctions.UserDatas and performed direct Redis lookups for _blocked_post_ec_, _blocked_users_ec_, and _deactive_users_ec.
    • src/Action/V1/Comments/ListPreviousComment.go and ListPreviousReplyComment.go returned HTTP 500 on database query errors.

  3. Notifications:

    • src/Action/V1/Notifications/ListNotifications.go manually called UserFunctions.UserDatas and read _deactive_users_ec and _blocked_users_ec_ from Redis, returning HTTP 500 on database failures.
    • src/Action/V1/Notifications/ListNotificationMonth.go performed identical manual user data and Redis blocked user lookups, returning HTTP 500 on query errors.

  4. Users:

    • src/Action/V1/Users/ProfileUser.go manually called UserFunctions.UserDatas and read deactivated/blocked users from Redis, returning HTTP 500 on social links and follow queries.
    • src/Action/V1/Users/ProfileUserBySid.go manually fetched blocked users from Redis.
    • src/Action/V1/Users/ProfileFollowing.go and ProfileFollower.go manually fetched deactivated and blocked users from Redis and returned HTTP 500 on query errors.

Scope

  • Extend Functions.ContentVisibility in src/Utils/Functions/Functions.go to include DeactivatedUsers []string so handlers that need to distinguish between deactivated users and blocked users can do so without manual Redis reads.
  • Refactor all 8 identified action files to use Functions.ResolveContentVisibility or Functions.ResolveUserVisibility:
    • src/Action/V1/Likes/ListProfileLikedPosts.go
    • src/Action/V1/Comments/PreviousCommentRequest.go
    • src/Action/V1/Comments/ListPreviousComment.go
    • src/Action/V1/Comments/ListPreviousReplyComment.go
    • src/Action/V1/Notifications/ListNotifications.go
    • src/Action/V1/Notifications/ListNotificationMonth.go
    • src/Action/V1/Users/ProfileUser.go
    • src/Action/V1/Users/ProfileUserBySid.go
    • src/Action/V1/Users/ProfileFollowing.go
    • src/Action/V1/Users/ProfileFollower.go
  • Standardize database scan/query errors from HTTP 500 to HTTP 400 Bad Request ("Failed to get data").
  • Remove redundant imports (context, Redis, UserFunctions) and manual pagination arithmetic.
  • Add unit tests for Comments/PreviousCommentRequest, Notifications/ListNotifications, and Users/ProfileUser.
  • Strictly preserve all API routes, parameter names, payload shapes, and encryption behaviors.

Behavior Boundary

The refactor must preserve:

  • All URL routes and parameter bindings.
  • Role checks (user, viewer, my-user) and header checks.
  • Blocked user and blocked post status codes (403 Forbidden with proper payloads).
  • All response messages and encryption envelopes (ec=true, cry, ls, e4).
  • Slim and worker files remain untouched.

Out of Scope

  • Changing database models or schema migrations.
  • Modifying slim models or slim response endpoints.
  • Auto-committing or pushing git changes.

Acceptance Criteria

  • All targeted action files use ResolveContentVisibility or ResolveUserVisibility.
  • Direct manual Redis calls to _deactive_users_ec, _blocked_users_ec_, and _blocked_post_ec_ are eliminated from non-slim action handlers.
  • Database query errors return HTTP 400 Bad Request instead of HTTP 500.
  • Unit tests pass with zero failures.
  • go build ./... succeeds without errors.

Delivery

Implemented in the working tree on 2026-09-14. No commit was created.

Implementation: Standardize Database Query Errors to HTTP 400 Across Actions

Summary

Standardized database scan, query, count, and data parsing failure responses across remaining non-slim action handlers from HTTP 500 Internal Server Error to HTTP 400 Bad Request ("Failed to get data"). issues.display_title: Issue #569: Refactor Users Module to GORM Models and Centralized Handlers
issues.main_description_html:
Implementation: Refactor Users Module to GORM Models and Centralized Handlers

Summary

Successfully completed Phase 1 (Users Module) of the GORM model migration. Replaced raw table string lookups (Table("users"), Table("followers"), Table("user_social_links"), etc.) with strongly-typed GORM models matching the pattern established in panorra-api-go-new. Created the missing UserSocialLink model, centralized remaining UserDatas calls to Functions.ResolveUserVisibility, and centralized pagination calculations.

Files Created & Updated

1. New Model

  • src/Models/UserSocialLink.go:
    • Added UserSocialLink struct mapped to table user_social_links.

2. Users Actions

  • src/Action/V1/Users/ProfileUser.go:
    • profileUserQuery: Bound to Model(&Models.User{}).
    • profileUserSocialLinksQuery: Bound to Model(&Models.UserSocialLink{}).
    • Check follow query: Bound to Model(&Models.Followers{}).
  • src/Action/V1/Users/ProfileUserBySid.go:
    • User check query: Bound to Model(&Models.User{}).
  • src/Action/V1/Users/ProfileFollowing.go:
    • User check query: Bound to Model(&Models.User{}).
    • profileFollowingQuery: Bound to Model(&Models.Followers{}).
  • src/Action/V1/Users/ProfileFollower.go:
    • User check query: Bound to Model(&Models.User{}).
    • profileFollowerQuery: Bound to Model(&Models.Followers{}).
  • src/Action/V1/Users/TotalBlockProfileUser.go:
    • User query: Bound to Model(&Models.User{}).
    • Follower queries: Bound to Model(&Models.Followers{}).Table("followers as f").
    • Like queries: Bound to Model(&Models.Like{}).Table("\"like\" AS l").
  • src/Action/V1/Users/UserDetail.go:
    • User queries: Bound to Model(&Models.User{}).
    • Detail queries: Bound to Model(&Models.UserDetail{}).
    • Account queries: Bound to Model(&Models.UserAccount{}).
    • Social link query: Bound to Model(&Models.UserSocialLink{}).
  • src/Action/V1/Users/ListBlockedUser.go:
    • Blocked query: Bound to Model(&Models.UserBlocks{}).Table("user_blocks as ub").
  • src/Action/V1/Users/ListAccountStreetView.go:
    • Street views query: Bound to Model(&Models.StreetViewsAccount{}).
    • Auth decode: Replaced UserFunctions.UserDatas with Functions.ResolveUserVisibility.
    • Pagination: Centralized using Functions.Pagination(c, 20).
  • src/Action/V1/Users/CheckSupport.go:
    • Replaced manual UserFunctions.UserDatas with Functions.ResolveUserVisibility (visibility.Email).
  • src/Action/V1/Users/CheckUsername.go:
    • Replaced manual UserFunctions.UserDatas with Functions.ResolveUserVisibility (visibility.Username).
  • src/Action/V1/Users/ListUserAccount.go:
    • Replaced manual UserFunctions.UserDatas with Functions.ResolveUserVisibility (visibility.LastLogin, visibility.UserId).
  • src/Action/V1/Users/SuggestionUserHalf.go:
    • Replaced manual UserFunctions.UserDatas with Functions.ResolveUserVisibility (visibility.LastLogin).
  • src/Action/V1/Users/SuggestionUserMore.go:
    • Centralized pagination calculation using Functions.Pagination(c, 10).

3. Unit Tests

  • src/Action/V1/Users/Users_handlers_test.go:
    • Added unit tests for ListBlockedUser, ListAccountStreetView, CheckSupport, CheckUsername, ListUserAccount, SuggestionUserHalf, and SuggestionUserMore.

Verification

go test -v -count=1 ./src/Action/V1/Users/...
go vet ./src/...
go build ./...
  • All 13 unit tests in Users package passed.
  • go vet reported zero issues.
  • go build ./... compiled successfully without errors.

Problem

Across the Users module in panorra-api-go, database queries relied on raw table string lookups (Config.DB.Table("users"), Table("followers"), Table("user_detail"), etc.) instead of strongly-typed GORM models like in panorra-api-go-new. This introduced:

  1. Lack of compile-time schema binding and relationship awareness.
  2. Missing GORM model for user_social_links.
  3. Ad-hoc manual calls to UserFunctions.UserDatas for basic auth checks in CheckSupport, CheckUsername, ListUserAccount, ListAccountStreetView, and SuggestionUserHalf.
  4. Manual pagination calculations in ListAccountStreetView and SuggestionUserMore.

Scope

  • Create dedicated model Models.UserSocialLink in src/Models/UserSocialLink.go (mapped to user_social_links).
  • Refactor all Users action queries from string Table("...") to GORM Model(&Models.XYZ{}):
    • ProfileUser.go: Bind to Models.User, Models.UserSocialLink, and Models.Followers.
    • ProfileUserBySid.go: Bind to Models.User.
    • ProfileFollowing.go: Bind to Models.User and Models.Followers.
    • ProfileFollower.go: Bind to Models.User and Models.Followers.
    • TotalBlockProfileUser.go: Bind to Models.User, Models.Followers, and Models.Like.
    • UserDetail.go: Bind to Models.User, Models.UserDetail, Models.UserAccount, and Models.UserSocialLink.
    • ListBlockedUser.go: Bind to Models.UserBlocks.
    • ListAccountStreetView.go: Bind to Models.StreetViewsAccount.
  • Centralize auth verification and user data retrieval to Functions.ResolveUserVisibility across:
    • ListAccountStreetView.go
    • CheckSupport.go
    • CheckUsername.go
    • ListUserAccount.go
    • SuggestionUserHalf.go
  • Centralize pagination using Functions.Pagination across:
    • ListAccountStreetView.go (default 20)

issues.main_description_html:
Implementation: Refactor Comments Module to GORM Models

Summary

Completed Phase 3 (Comments Module) of the GORM model migration in panorra-api-go. Replaced raw table string queries (Table("posts"), Table("comment"), Table("like_comment")) with strongly-typed GORM models (Models.Post, Models.Comment, Models.LikeComment).

Files Updated

1. Comments Action Handlers

  • src/Action/V1/Comments/ListComments.go:
    • Replaced post check Config.DB.Table("posts") with Config.DB.Model(&Models.Post{}).
  • src/Action/V1/Comments/ListPreviousComment.go:
    • Replaced target comment check Config.DB.Table("comment as c") with Config.DB.Model(&Models.Comment{}).Table("comment as c").
  • src/Action/V1/Comments/ListPreviousReplyComment.go:
    • Replaced target check Config.DB.Table("comment c") with Config.DB.Model(&Models.Comment{}).Table("comment as c").
    • Replaced replies query Config.DB.Table("comment c") with Config.DB.Model(&Models.Comment{}).Table("comment as c").
  • src/Action/V1/Comments/ListRepliesComment.go:
    • Replaced post check Config.DB.Table("posts") with Config.DB.Model(&Models.Post{}).
    • Replaced replies query Config.DB.Table("comment c") with Config.DB.Model(&Models.Comment{}).Table("comment as c").
    • Made c.Locals("userId") extraction nil-safe to avoid panic on unauthenticated requests.
  • src/Action/V1/Comments/TotalBlockedComment.go:
    • Replaced post lookup db.Table("posts") with db.Model(&Models.Post{}).
    • Replaced subquery db.Table("comment") with db.Model(&Models.Comment{}).
    • Replaced blocked comments count Config.DB.Table("comment as c") with Config.DB.Model(&Models.Comment{}).Table("comment as c").
  • src/Action/V1/Comments/TotalBlockedLikeComment.go:
    • Replaced blocked comment likes count Config.DB.Table("like_comment lc") with Config.DB.Model(&Models.LikeComment{}).Table("like_comment as lc").
  • src/Action/V1/Comments/LikedComments.go:
    • Replaced query builder likedCommentSlugsQuery from db.Table("like_comment") to db.Model(&Models.LikeComment{}).

  1. ListComments.go: used string table lookup for target post check (Table("posts")).

  7. LikedComments.go: used string table lookup for batch liked comment slugs (Table("like_comment")).
